// why: This file is deliberately EXEMPTED from the '.vscode/*' entry in .gitignore.
VS Code 1.104+ ships Mermaid rendering for the Markdown preview BUILT IN, as
the bundled extension vscode.mermaid-markdown-features. Nothing needs to be
installed for docs/ diagrams to render - just open the Markdown Preview
(Ctrl+Shift+V).
bierner.markdown-mermaid is therefore listed as UNWANTED, not recommended.
It predates the built-in support and does the same job with the same
'markdown-mermaid.*' config namespace and the same markdown.previewScripts
contribution, so installing both puts TWO different Mermaid builds in one
webview, racing to render the same <pre class="mermaid"> nodes. The loser can
replace or re-parse the winner's output, and the diagram silently comes out
BLANK with no error. That was the root cause of the recurring 2026-07-27 and
2026-07-28 'I cannot see the diagrams' reports.
If diagrams are missing, run: npm run docs:mermaid:doctor
ms-sarifvscode.sarif-viewer is listed as UNWANTED. It activates on
'workspaceContains:.git' and attaches diagnostics to EVERY open text
document, including the 'chat-editing-text-model:' documents that Copilot
chat session restore creates. On 2026-08-21 that turned restoring a large
chat session into an extension-host stall: 1,210 updateDiags calls, 1,153 of
them against chat-editing models, with the host repeatedly unresponsive.
CodeQL results are already gated in CI (.github/workflows/codeql.yml); the
editor-side viewer is not required to ship or review them.
